Feel the searing pain. It is not bad you are experiencing it. It will sizzle your belly into delicious, new being.

Honour it, because it is what is there to share.

Never forget—she is a woman, and she can be loved. Stay open to the constant flirtation with the universe. At first, nothing is erotic, then something is, then it is everything.
